verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a published uptime SLA or a public status page for MoQ Relay or its public test relay at cdn.moq.dev. The clustering and failover claims describe architectural resilience, which is an adjacent feature. It is not a vendor reliability commitment or incident-visibility page, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, the vendor publishes an uptime SLA and a public status page I can check during an incident
